intro.text: In Vorin belief, the army of the Heralds that fights the Voidbringers for the Tranquiline Halls in the War for Heaven.

description.text: It is said the sound of a horn will call the Heraldic Forces to battle.

Ardents teach that those who best fulfil their Callings rise after death to join the Heralds, gaining powers from their Calling: a farmer could grow whole fields with a gesture, a spearman make thunder.
Once the Heraldic Forces retake the Tranquiline Halls, those not chosen will wake from their sleep and return there.
